resources.string:
Place your finger on the camera, covering the flash as well, then press Start. The flash lights up, and the measurement begins once the app sees your finger and the colour has stopped changing. 

This utility works by measuring the amount of red it sees through the camera, and attempting to detect the fluctuations. 
It works better in a darkened room, and when the pressure on the camera is constant. 
If there are multiple cameras on your device, make sure that your finger covers the entire field of view in the small viewfinder. 
Once the measurement is complete, press New measurement to clear it and take another. Every finished reading is saved in the Log tab, where you can tag it with an activity and duration, mark it as invalid, and export it. Changing the activity or the valid/invalid mark under the result changes that log entry too. 
A reading whose beats are irregular, or that shows no clear pulse, is marked invalid automatically; the button under the result marks or unmarks one by hand.
